newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Serbia shipyard launches ship for Dutch buyer - paper.
newsitem.headline: Serbia shipyard launches ship for Dutch buyer - paper.

text.p: Serbia's Begej shipyard has launched a 100-metre river container ship with a capacity of 3,000 tonnes for a buyer in the Netherlands, Belgrade newspaper Politika reported on Thursday.

The ship, to be completely equipped in the Netherlands, was launched on Wednesday and is the fourth to come out of the Begej shipyard since sanctions against Yugoslavia, comprising Serbia and Montenegro, were formally lifted in October 1996.
The shipyard will manufacture another eight ships on the basis of the contract signed with the Dutch buyer Chaim Dansen last year, Begej director Milan Visnjic was quoted as saying.
No other details were immediately available. -- Amra Kevic, Belgrade newsroom +381 11 222 4305
